installCommand: if [ -d frontend ] && [ -d backend ]; then npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install; else npm install && npm --prefix ../backend install; fi
buildCommand: if [ -d frontend ] && [ -d backend ]; then npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npx --prefix backend prisma db push && npm --prefix frontend run build; else npm --prefix ../backend run prisma:generate && npx --prefix ../backend prisma db push && npm run build; fi
